## Project Overview Website for "Spice Route Exports" — a spice export business. Static site with HTML and CSS. Includes a navbar, hero section, products section, logos/certifications section, contact section, and a WhatsApp float button. ## Completed Work - Added `padding: 0 24px` to `.logo-link` in `style.css` to give navbar logo breathing room (turned out to be wrong issue) - Added `padding: 0 16px` to `.nav-inner` in `style.css` to reduce navbar side spacing (turned out to be wrong issue) - Reduced `.logo-img` `max-width` from `160px` to `120px` (turned out to be wrong issue — user clarified the "logo section" is the certifications section, not the navbar) - Identified the actual issue: the "logos section" (`
`) is the "Trusted By & Certified" section with certification logos — user was referring to this, not the navbar logo - Found phone number occurrences in index.html: display text `+91 98242 40521` (line 351) and WhatsApp links using `919824240521` (lines 373 and 467) - **Updated phone number to `+91 81284 97521` across all 3 locations in index.html** (lines 351, 373, 467) — completed successfully ## Key Technical Decisions - Navbar uses CSS Grid: `grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr` with logo in center `auto` column - `.container` class: `max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 40px` - `.nav-inner` has both `nav-inner` and `container` classes applied; `padding: 0 16px` on `.nav-inner` overrides `.container` padding - Logos section (`logos-section`) uses `.container` for layout ## Relevant Files & Code - `index.html` — main HTML file; open in VSCode - `style.css` — main stylesheet; open in VSCode Key CSS blocks (current state): ```css .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 40px; } .nav-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; height: 72px; padding: 0 16px; } .logo-link { justify-self: center; padding: 0 24px; } .logo-img { height: 52px; max-width: 120px; width: auto; object-fit: contain; } .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 32px; } .nav-links-left { justify-self: end; } .nav-links-right { justify-self: start; } ``` Phone number (current state — updated): - Line 351: `+91 81284 97521` - Line 373: `href="https://wa.me/918128497521?..."` - Line 467: `href="https://wa.me/918128497521?..."` Logos section HTML (lines 110–129): ```html

Trusted By & Certified

× 5 (+ duplicates for loop)
``` ## Current Status Phone number update completed successfully. All three occurrences of the old number (`+91 98242 40521` / `919824240521`) have been replaced with the new number (`+91 81284 97521` / `918128497521`) in index.html. No pending active tasks. ## Pending Tasks - (Deferred) Fix left/right spacing in the logos/certifications section (`logos-section`) — user's original complaint before pivoting to phone number task
